0.original: Lady Genevieve wants you to gather the gil which you caused her to drop on the ground.

1.original: Shocked at being addressed by a common adventurer, Lady Genevieve has dropped a large quantity of gil on the ground. Collect the coins and beg forgiveness.

2.original: You have gathered all of Genevieve's gil. Return it to her before you receive another scolding.

3.original: Lady Genevieve is mollified upon receiving her precious gil. Rather than offering any words of gratitude, she gives you a pittance and proceeds to ignore you.

49.original: What have you <hex:021A020203>done<hex:021A020103>!? Your kind has no business to even <hex:021A020203>look<hex:021A020103> at a lady such as I.

50.original: Such shocking, unbelievable insolence! And now look─look at how my gil is scattered across the ground!

51.original: Pick it up, right this instant!

52.original: My gil...<hex:021A020203>now<hex:021A020103>! And there had better be naught missing!

53.original: Hmmm, this appears to be everything.

54.original: ...What are you still staring at? Are you expecting some kind of reward? The insolence! Hmph!
